The '''Battle of Behpour''' took place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Behpour/Legends|Behpour]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].

==Prelude==
After the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] [[Mission to Alzoc III|discovered]] a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] being destroyed by a [[gravitic polarization beam]] on [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]]. Further investigation by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] revealed the culprit to be [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], who stole of the bombs from his rival, [[Kul Teska]]. Teska was planning to use the beam to destroy the [[Naboo (star)/Legends|Naboo sun]] and prove his worth to [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Meanwhile, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who was investigating a rumored [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] base near [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], was kidnapped by Teska's droids. Discovering her disappearance, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], accompanied by Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], led an army of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] to infiltrate and destroy the laboratory.

==The battle==
[[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] created a diversion while [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi sneaked into the [[Behpour facility|droid facility]] and destroyed the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], allowing the main body of [[Troop/Legends|troops]], commanded by Mace Windu and Ahsoka Tano, to destroy the main building. Inside, Skywalker and Tano faced Kul Teska, while Rex, Cody, and [[Ponds/Legends|Ponds]] brought the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] to the rendezvous point. While the three clone troopers were waiting by the ''Twilight'', Dooku arrived. The clone troopers retaliated with [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]], but were force pushed to the inside of the ''Twilight''. Dooku closed the freighter's doors and dropped an overhead piece of equipment on top of it with [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]]. By the time [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] Kenobi and Windu arrived, the [[Count/Legends|Count]] had already gotten away with it. After a short duel, Windu and Kenobi defeated Dooku. Before they could kill him, however, the platform they were standing on started to collapse. Mace Windu and Obi-Wan jumped aboard the ''Twilight'' that somehow either the clones or [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] was able to keep from crashing. Dooku fell, only to be saved by [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] piloting a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|Sheathipede-class transport shuttle]], in which they escaped. Meanwhile, Skywalker and his Padawan had battled and defeated Teska (with some unexpected help from Cad Bane) and saved Senator Amidala before the duel, whom Anakin informed about a [[Power regulator/Legends|power regulator]] he and Ahsoka passed by on their way. Padmé later sabotaged the weapon via the power regulator. In the end, the Jedi and clone officers escaped with the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]], leaving Teska and his experiments to die in the burning wreckage of the laboratory.
